story.iWant: to measure object width using C axis floating switch
story.soThat: the picker jaw can detect object size automatically

tasks.task: Define floating switch configuration constants (CMD_WIDTH, AXIS_HAS_FLOATING_SWITCH macro, error codes)
Create FloatingSwitchHandler module in safety_monitor component
Implement floating switch detection logic (direction-aware, closing only)
Implement width calculation from position at contact
Implement width event publication (EVENT WIDTH C value)
Implement measurement reset on new close motion
Integration with limit_monitor for C_LIMIT_MAX handling

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Floating switch detection distinct from hard limit - motion stops but no ERROR state set
Width measurement calculated on floating switch trigger as current_position
EVENT WIDTH C value published within 10ms of switch activation
WIDTH C command returns last measurement or -1.000 if none
Floating switch only active during closing motion (negative direction)
Width reset on new close motion start
I2C coordination with limit_monitor via shared MCP0 Port B interrupt

constraints.constraint: Header-Only Configuration: Every configurable value MUST be defined in a header file. No magic numbers in source code.
Dual-Core Separation: Core 0 handles communication and safety monitoring, Core 1 handles motion control.
Event-Driven Safety: Safety task is fully event-driven using interrupts and FreeRTOS task notifications.
I2C Coordination: All MCP23017 access must use mcp23017_wrapper mutex for thread-safe I2C bus access.
Floating switch uses C_LIMIT_MAX input (MCP0 GPB3) - shares interrupt with B-E limit switches. Must distinguish from hard limit handling.
Only C axis has floating switch feature (picker jaw). WIDTH command must reject other axes.
Floating switch detection only valid during closing motion (negative direction). Ignore switch activation during opening.

tests.standards: Per project testing strategy: Unit tests use Unity framework in component test directories. Integration tests use actual hardware when available. Mock external dependencies (MCP23017, motion_controller) for unit tests. Tests follow naming pattern test_*.c for C tests.
